findings.passage: Our elections should be the cleanest and most secure in the entire world. We need to pass the SAVE America Act to ensure only American citizens vote in our elections, mandate photo ID, and purge noncitizens from voter rolls. Every American citizen deserves to have their voice heard in our elections, and if we let fraud or illegal votes flood the system, then the voices of Americans are diluted.
findings.note: Under the heading 'Safeguard Our Elections' on his campaign platform page (page published 2026-05-16). He calls for passing the SAVE America Act, a photo ID mandate, and removing non-citizens from voter rolls.
